title: Class Game Notes
description: Running short games in a classroom or club: devices, groups, scoring and getting started without losing ten minutes. Notes by Ahmed Moaz.
blurb: Games in class work when setup is quick, every student is doing something and nobody ends the lesson as the loser. These notes cover the practical side: devices, groups, scoring and timing.
about: I am Ahmed Moaz. I build Boardit, a small site of free browser games for people aged 13 and over. Some teachers use games like these in class.
This blog is about the practical side of running games with a class or club. I have not taught a class myself; where a note relies on published research, it says so.
